snippet.title: Mirai #167 - Official Demo Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Step into the sci-fi world of Mirai #167 in this trailer for the upcoming 2D pixel-art runner game, where you control two characters at once, rewinding time and jumping through portals. Embark on a frantic adventure to save humanity in a world where AI surpasses human control - upgrade your characters, break records and rewrite history before it’s too late. Mirai #167 will be available on PC in Q1 2026, and a demo is coming soon to Steam.
